title: EditUI — Point at your UI. Tell your coding agent what to change.
excerpt: Point at your UI. Tell your coding agent what to change. Click elements in Chrome, collect the edits, and copy one prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, or any coding agent.
content_html:
EditUI

Review your running app in Chrome. Click any element, leave an edit, collect as many as you want, then send them all to Claude Code, Cursor or your coding agent.

① Clicks the heading. Make this heading slightly smaller.

How it works

Point → Prompt → Collect → Send

  1. 01

    Point

    Click anything on your running UI.

  2. 02

    Prompt

    Describe what you want changed.

  3. 03

    Collect

    Keep reviewing. EditUI remembers every edit.

  4. 04

    Send

    Copy the whole review and paste it into your coding agent.

Stop explaining which element you mean.

EditUI captures the context your coding agent needs to understand what you are pointing at.

No screenshots to annotate. No selectors to copy. No source files to hunt down.

  • element
  • text
  • DOM
  • classes
  • parent
  • nearby elements
  • URL
  • viewport
  • computed styles

Fix the whole page in one pass.

UI review does not happen one issue at a time. Collect everything you notice, then let your coding agent handle the batch.

Batch UI edits

Review

  1. 1Reduce hero height
  2. 2Align these cards
  3. 3Make this CTA secondary
  4. 4Tighten this spacing
  5. 5Stack these on mobile

Send 5 edits →

Works with the agent you already use.

  • Claude Code
  • Cursor
  • Codex
  • Windsurf
  • Copy anywhere

Cursor Design Mode in ChromeCursor Visual Editor

Your coding agent can fix it.

Just show it what you mean.
